decks.notes: This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and control of the game. It utilizes powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Demonic Tutor to draw into key cards and gain an advantage. The deck also includes efficient removal like Fatal Push and Wasteland to deal with threats, as well as counterspells like Spell Pierce and Force of Will to protect its own game plan. With Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck can also utilize its graveyard resources effectively to outvalue the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive strategy using artifact creatures and land destruction. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to ramp up quickly, along with Chalice of the Void and Sphere of Resistance to disrupt the opponent's spells, the deck aims to control the game and push through for a quick victory. Additionally, cards like Crucible of Worlds and Strip Mine provide additional land destruction options, while Golos, Tireless Pilgrim offers potential for card advantage and utility.

The key strategy of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt opponents with counterspells and removal while efficiently drawing cards and managing resources. By controlling the tempo of the game and out-valuing opponents through card advantage, the deck aims to maintain board control and eventually win through either a combo finish or overwhelming card advantage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and recursion, amplifying the deck's ability to grind out wins in a long game.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent through counter spells, removal, and card advantage while utilizing Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion to provide additional value. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, protect its own threats, and eventually win through incremental advantage and efficient card selection. The inclusion of powerful artifacts and efficient mana sources allows the deck to maintain consistent pressure and adapt to different game situations, ultimately outplaying the opponent through careful planning and resource management.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. This Dimir Control deck focuses on using a combination of disruption spells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Orcish Bowmasters to deal with threats, while Lórien Revealed provides additional card draw. With a compact mana base and powerful one-mana spells, this deck aims to control the game and eventually win through attrition.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and mana acceleration to disrupt opponent's strategies while efficiently advancing its own game plan. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting opponent's plays, this deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, then utilizing cards like Ichorid and Narcomoeba to bring back powerful creatures. Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam provide additional value when they are put into play from the graveyard. The combination of Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder allows for efficient deck manipulation and graveyard filling. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Grief to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

With lock-out effects like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while pressing its own advantage with aggressive plays.
